purpose: Finite SDR/Q4 texture clip scalar weights; not painted colours, displacement, PNG approximations or external image acceptance.

inputDomain.reject: Nonfinite values, values outside[0,1], negative zero, and any f32 not bit-equal to a normalized Q4 node. Both inputs must be valid, including when one is zero.

nativeProvenance.origin: Independent authored Metal numeric probes on synthetic alpha inputs, no vendor program and no image/node inputs.
nativeProvenance.graphProof: All16654561 ordered pairs: fast-compiled pow(a,.2)*pow(b,.2) equals the explicit fast_log2/fast_exp2 graph compiled without reassociation; zero differences.
nativeProvenance.exp2Readback: 4516119 unique raw-f32 exp2 arguments with corresponding real native fast_exp2 outputs. Every nonzero alpha-pair graph input is found in that table.

baseline.unaryLut: 4081 little-endian f32 values, independently checked against material::fifth_root for all inputs.
baseline.warning: Baseline alone is not the target. Signed ULP corrections are required.

residualLayout.symmetry: The two finite log operands add commutatively bit-for-bit; all ordered graph inputs checked.
residualLayout.storedCode: delta+5; even index in low nibble, odd index in high nibble; final high nibble padding zero.
residualLayout.reconstruction: Return positive f32 bit pattern baseline.to_bits()+decodedCode-5.

limitations: This is the measured Apple fast-math contract on exact SDR/Q4 alpha nodes. Arbitrary-alpha/HDR clipping and external image parity are not established. Input colours and GPU-rendered output remain local to their backend.
